title: Urban Land Cover — Random Forest

paper.title: Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification

protocol.name: repository-deterministic
protocol.description: Repository notebook logic with the previously unspecified validation split fixed to seed 42.
protocol.scaling: z-score each train and test column independently, matching the notebook

comparison.note: Product threshold for the demo verdict, not a test of statistical equivalence.

knownDiscrepancies: The paper states fixed seeds, but the repository notebook leaves train_test_split random_state unset.
The paper says the validation split is stratified, but the repository notebook does not pass stratify.
The paper says test features reuse training statistics, but the repository notebook z-scores the test set independently.
The notebook expects urbantraining.csv and urbantesting.csv while the official archive provides training.csv and testing.csv.
